info.name: Full Text Search - PostgreSQL
info.summary: PostgreSQL platform for Full Text Search
info.description:
Index and search your Nextcloud using PostgreSQL's built-in full-text search, with no extra search server.
- Weighted ranking (title > tags > comments/parts > content) with highlighted excerpts - Prefix matching while typing, "exact phrases", -exclusions and OR - Typo-tolerant title matching with pg_trgm - Every text search language your PostgreSQL server ships, including Turkish - Respects ownership and shares to users, groups and teams - Text extraction for plain text, OpenDocument and Office files, and PDFs (with pdftotext)
Requires Nextcloud to run on PostgreSQL 12 or newer, plus the Full Text Search app.
info.author: surfcu
